name.zh: 六米代表性潮坪教学片区

description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: broad low-gradient surface cut by shallow drainage runnels. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants.
description.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：极缓坡面被浅小排水沟切开。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。

sources.title: Estuary Landforms
sources.supports: Estuary and tidal-flat setting; not a specific prehistoric coast
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Geological-form artistic concept: six-metre-wide low-gradient landscape teaching patch. One continuous surface carries a shallow winding main runnel and three connected tributaries merging downhill toward the front outlet; channel depth is actual geometry, and the muted darker mud palette is not a water simulation. Original nominal spacing, slope, crop thickness and colors; not a complete shoreline survey, a measured prehistoric terrain, or a hand-scale rock. Original scale_class landscape and coast biome preserved.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 地质形态艺术概念：六米宽低坡 landscape 教学片区。连续表面包含一条浅弯主沟及三条向前出口汇流的支沟；沟深来自实际几何，柔和深色泥面不是水体模拟。沟间距、坡度、截取厚度及色彩为原创名义设定，不是完整海岸测绘、实测史前地形或手掌小石。保留原始scale_class landscape及coast生境。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
